english: It suddenly occurred to one of the workers to open up the box.
text: 中文说“某人突然想到”，很容易顺着语序翻成 someone suddenly thought of。这句用 It occurred to one of the workers to open up the box，是把“想到主意”当成一件自然冒出来的事，it 指代后面真正的主语 to open up the box。下次想表达“某人突然想到要做某事”，可以用 It occurs/occurred to sb to do sth，更符合英语常用视角。
author: doubao-seed-2-1-turbo-260628
